target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays — project Hays-local source pool with wild observations; Travis — published Texas specimen record; Williamson — dedicated county treatment.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the bark and fruiting heads. American sycamore has dramatically exfoliating mottled bark that exposes chalky white to pale tan patches, huge alternate palmately lobed leaves, and round hanging fruiting balls made of many achenes.
diagnostic_traits: mottled exfoliating bark with white/tan upper trunk patches
very large alternate palmately lobed leaves
petiole base encloses the axillary bud
spherical flower/fruit heads on long peduncles
